sloka: हारकेयूरवस्त्रैश्च शस्त्रैश्च समलङ्कृता ।भूमिर्भाति रणे तत्र शारदीव यथा निशा ।। ६.५३.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: hārakeyūravastraiśca śastraiśca samalaṅkṛtā ।bhūmirbhāti raṇe tatra śāradīva yathā niśā ।। 6.53.31 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the wonderful chariots, flags, horses, Vanaras and Rakshasas bodies bathed in blood fell on the ground looked fearful.
